contract.subject: KYX.IO desktop Inkfall vertical slice compared with public ev.io interaction principles
contract.buildIdentity: main baseline ddcd7112b1e64a036a3cde89dc2f3893a0af0b9c plus the preserved uncommitted local Inkfall Practice convergence batch
contract.mode: KYX local /practice with one player and seven deterministic bots; deployed KYX Iron Bastion Practice; public ev.io live Deathmatch; public ev.io node configuration
contract.platform: Windows desktop Chrome, keyboard and mouse, direct pointer-lock play; 1440x900 local evidence viewport
contract.playerPromise: A fast, readable, authoritative arena FPS where movement, weapons, abilities, feedback, and HUD communicate one coherent rule set
contract.decision: Identify and correct contracts that are technically implemented but player-facing wrong before expanding the vertical slice
contract.decisionOwner: Project owner for subjective play, visual, and audio acceptance; canonical authority code owns deterministic mechanics
constraints: Keep all project writes on the physical D drive
Preserve the current dirty Practice convergence batch
Do not copy protected ev.io code, art, audio, maps, or expression
Use public behavior only to extract interaction principles and independently author KYX implementations
Treat automated gates, runtime evidence, and human acceptance as separate states
nonGoals: This audit does not approve current character, map, HUD, audio, or VFX aesthetics
This bounded correction does not rebalance every cooldown, charge count, fuse, or projectile radius
This audit does not promote mobile or broaden the map, weapon, or role catalog
successSignals: Sustained movement changes the local player's authoritative feet position in the Inkfall world
Launch follows a visible gravity arc, ignores player-body collision, never rebounds, and activates on first qualifying world contact
Practice and online consume the same authority rules and communicate the same event once
Each important action has timely, non-conflicting animation, VFX, audio, HUD, and recovery feedback
failureSignals: A test counts accepted inputs while the authoritative player remains stationary
Launch bounces, floats without gravity, collides with a player body, or sounds like two separate impacts
Legacy, Practice, and online routes expose contradictory mechanics under the same ability name
A PASS label is used as visual, audio, play, or release acceptance
stopConditions: A route would enter public matchmaking or affect other players
The source identity changes during a supposedly source-frozen comparison
Pointer-lock or automation limitations make a claimed observation invalid
A proposed asset lacks license or provenance clearance

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.claim: The current KYX Practice route renders Inkfall at full desktop viewport with one first-person rifle and visible procedural opponents.
contradictions: The procedural enemy bodies and map art remain human-unaccepted.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.claim: Public ev.io entered a live Drought/Brazil Deathmatch. Forward sprint moved the player, and Q exposed an orange destination marker before left-click commitment produced one immediate cyan-white Impulse resolution and player displacement without a visible rebound sequence.
observations.evidence: Direct Windows Chrome pointer-lock play at https://ev.io/ on 2026-07-31
observations.scope: Public live match, direct keyboard and mouse input
contradictions: This qualitative pass does not quantify exact acceleration, impulse strength, cooldown, latency, or repeatability.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.claim: The KYX Practice event loop currently routes portal audio but does not itself consume the throwable-ability audio presentation used by the online route.
observations.scope: Current source before the Launch correction
contradictions: Weapon fire and impacts have a separate authored audio owner inside onlineWeaponPresentationFx.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.claim: The deployed KYX preview can enter and move through legacy Iron Bastion Practice, but it is not the new Inkfall /practice route. A large blocky bot initially occluded the camera, while the first-person rifle and HUD used a different visual hierarchy from ev.io's sparse center-clear presentation.
observations.evidence: Direct Windows Chrome pointer-lock play at https://kyx-io-preview.pages.dev on 2026-07-31
contradictions: This proves movement only for deployed Iron Bastion and cannot approve the dirty local Inkfall route.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.claim: The dirty local Inkfall /practice route accepted sustained forward-sprint input and exceeded meaningful horizontal displacement before the authority failed with PHYSICS_DEPENETRATION_FAILED near tick 13.
observations.scope: Local fixed-20-Hz Practice authority, one player plus seven deterministic bots
contradictions: Movement is proven to begin, but uninterrupted traversal and free-play durability are not proven.

measurements.label: MEASURED
measurements.claim: ev.io's public Impulse Grenade data disables both wall and ground bounce and assigns gravity 0.048 at a fixed 20 Hz update rate.
measurements.method: Read the public live node data and map per-tick velocity decrement to SI acceleration.
measurements.value: bounceOfWalls=false; bounceOfGround=false; gravity=0.048, equivalent to 19.2 m/s^2 at 20 Hz
measurements.scope: Public ev.io node 355 behavior data, not copied implementation

measurements.label: MEASURED
measurements.claim: The pre-correction KYX dedicated Impulse authority rule has zero gravity and permits three bounces.
measurements.method: Static inspection of the exact authority rule and collision step.
measurements.value: acceleration y=0 mm/s^2; maximumBounces=3; 30-tick post-contact fuse

measurements.label: MEASURED
measurements.claim: The local Inkfall Practice player moved more than 400 mm horizontally and reached more than 1,000 mm/s horizontal authority velocity under sustained forward-sprint input before the penetration failure.
measurements.method: Browser test recorded initial/final authority feet position and velocity from localAuthoritativePlayer diagnostics.
measurements.value: horizontal displacement >400 mm; horizontal velocity >1,000 mm/s; failure near tick 13
measurements.scope: Current dirty /practice route, not a release or soak result

measurements.label: MEASURED
measurements.claim: Canonical Launch v2 now implements one gravity-driven, zero-bounce, world-only first-contact terminal authority rule with player-body collision excluded, v2 checkpoint rejection, deterministic event ordering, and coalesced presentation cues.
measurements.method: Consolidated source-matched gate: app and Worker typechecks, focused ESLint, seven app test files with 33 passing tests, one Worker projection file with four passing tests, and focused diff check.
measurements.value: all listed automated checks passed; gravity=-19,200 mm/s^2; launch speed=18,000 mm/s; restitution=0; friction=0
measurements.scope: Current dirty canonical source batch; automated mechanics and contract proof only, not human player-eye feel or release approval

measurements.label: MEASURED
measurements.claim: Inkfall Revision 4 removes the diagnosed east-choice rail wedge without changing any other collider or the render, spawn, zone, and trigger packages.
measurements.method: Exact collider-delta regression plus two byte-identical deterministic 1+7-player local Practice simulations through 300 ticks.
measurements.value: one collider changed; former approximately 292 mm platform clearance becomes 421 mm; both 300-tick rooms completed beyond the former tick-163 failure
measurements.scope: Revision 4 authority candidate and bounded deterministic test window; not broad player-eye traversal, 2/4/8 online proof, or soak

resources: three selectable ability charges and cooldowns
goals: Move, aim, fight, use vertical mobility, and understand outcomes without diagnostic overlays
Win team deathmatch through legible positioning and combat decisions

rules.claim: Movement and combat outcomes are owned by a fixed 20 Hz authority model.
rules.owner: local Practice host or room Worker

rules.claim: A playable route is not accepted until movement survives ordinary uninterrupted traversal without authority penetration failure.
rules.owner: Rapier/KCC movement authority and matching map collision profile

rules.claim: Launch is a gravity-driven, surface-triggered mobility charge, not a rebounding grenade-launcher round.

signals: muzzle, projectile, contact, detonation, hit, headshot, and kill VFX
weapon, locomotion, ability, impact, ambience, and UI audio
Cutline HUD, scoreboard, menus, cooldown fills, captions, and accessibility modes
feedbackLoops: Movement creates position advantage, which changes line of sight, damage opportunity, score, respawn, and route choice.
Clear ability prediction and contact feedback teach trajectory and encourage deliberate mobility plays.
delaysAndThresholds: human perception thresholds for input, hit, and audio feedback

hypotheses.label: INFERRED
hypotheses.symptom: Launch rebounds in KYX although the reference interaction does not.
hypotheses.mechanism: A generic throwable or grenade-launcher bounce model was reused for a distinct mobility ability.
evidenceAgainst: MEASURE-004 shows the known duplicate authority and fallback behavior has been replaced in the current source batch.
hypotheses.predictionIfTrue: Changing the dedicated authority rule and every reachable same-name fallback removes rebounds deterministically in Practice and online.
hypotheses.predictionIfFalse: A rebound remains after authority velocity becomes terminal, implicating presentation interpolation or duplicate simulation.
hypotheses.discriminatingTest: Inject one qualifying world contact and assert zero outgoing rebound plus same-tick terminal detonation, then capture the player-eye route.

hypotheses.label: INFERRED
hypotheses.mechanism: Collision and detonation are rendered as two independent contact cues, creating a false second impact even if authority is terminal.
evidenceAgainst: MEASURE-002 proves there was also a real authority rebound.
MEASURE-004 shows collision and detonation presentation cues are coalesced in the corrected source batch.
hypotheses.predictionIfTrue: After mechanics are fixed, the action still feels like a double contact until cues are coalesced.
hypotheses.predictionIfFalse: One terminal audiovisual event reads cleanly without cue changes.
hypotheses.discriminatingTest: Record reliable event order and audio attempts for one collision-detonation tick.

hypotheses.label: INFERRED
hypotheses.symptom: Launch appears to rebound or hesitate at contact.
hypotheses.mechanism: Interpolation displays a stale airborne state after the terminal authority event.
evidenceAgainst: The pre-correction authority source specified a real rebound.
MEASURE-004 closes the known authority and event-order causes; only player-eye capture can now expose residual interpolation.
hypotheses.predictionIfTrue: Authority tests pass while player-eye capture still shows one post-contact lift or linger frame.
hypotheses.predictionIfFalse: The projectile disappears at the contact point once terminal authority state is rendered.
hypotheses.discriminatingTest: Compare event tick, snapshot removal tick, and rendered projectile frames in a source-frozen capture.

hypotheses.label: INFERRED
hypotheses.symptom: Inkfall Practice aborts shortly after otherwise valid forward-sprint movement.
hypotheses.mechanism: The player KCC or a bot enters geometry that cannot be depenetrated under the current Rev5 visual versus revision-3 collision/spawn contract.
evidenceAgainst: MEASURE-005 shows the same deterministic 1+7-player execution continues through 300 ticks after the isolated rail correction.
hypotheses.predictionIfTrue: Actor, position, and collider diagnostics will identify a reproducible spawn/traversal seam, and a matching collision/spawn correction will permit the same itinerary to continue.
hypotheses.predictionIfFalse: The failure moves nondeterministically or remains after the implicated geometry/spawn is corrected, suggesting a KCC integration or bot-command issue.
hypotheses.discriminatingTest: Capture failing actor id, tick, feet position, velocity, spawn id, collider id, penetration vector, and last accepted command; rerun the same seed after a bounded correction.

consequenceLadders.change: Make Launch a gravity-driven, no-player-collision projectile that activates on first qualifying world contact without rebound.
consequenceLadders.label: PROPOSED
consequenceLadders.immediate: The projectile arcs downward and terminates at the first valid surface instead of ricocheting or waiting through a post-contact fuse.
consequenceLadders.behavioral: Players can intentionally place mobility blasts and learn one reliable trajectory/contact rule.
consequenceLadders.counterplay: Opponents can read the arc and avoid the destination or exploit the user's committed trajectory; players cannot bank it around corners.
consequenceLadders.systemic: Authority collision layers, checkpoint compatibility, reliable event ordering, Practice/online presentation, audio, captions, documentation, and tests must agree.
consequenceLadders.temporal: Repeated use becomes a learned movement skill instead of unpredictable ricochet fishing.
consequenceLadders.failure: Immediate contact could self-launch unintentionally near cover, double audio could imply a rebound, or legacy routes could preserve contradictory behavior.
consequenceLadders.recovery: Fail closed on old checkpoint capability, emit one ordered terminal event sequence, expose cooldown state in HUD, and retain a safe lifetime fallback.
unknowns: Final launch impulse tuning and self-affect rules require a human play pass after deterministic semantics are fixed.

perspectives.goal: Move and understand what each ability will do after one or two uses.
predictionErrors: A utility named Launch currently behaves like a bouncing explosive.
A Practice action may lack the online route's ability audio feedback.
tradeoffs: A simple terminal contact rule is easier to learn than bank-shot behavior but offers less indirect placement.

perspectives.goal: Master trajectories, timing, route openings, and counter-positioning.
predictionErrors: Different same-name rules across routes destroy transferable mastery.
tradeoffs: Removing ricochet reduces surprise but increases intentionality and counterplay clarity.

perspectives.goal: Ship one source-frozen, deterministic, supportable vertical slice.
predictionErrors: Accepted-input or schema tests can pass while the player-facing rule is wrong.
Parallel legacy and authority implementations can silently diverge.
tradeoffs: Failing old checkpoints is safer than restoring an in-flight projectile under different physics.

creativeDirection.promise: KYX combat should feel like precise industrial motion: readable weight, immediate authority, and restrained instruments rather than arcade noise.
creativeDirection.worldThesis: Inkfall is an active vertical foundry whose structure, machinery, portals, and combat technology share one engineered visual and sonic language.
creativeDirection.interactionThesis: Every action previews intent, commits with weight, resolves once, and leaves a clear spatial consequence.
creativeDirection.antiThesis: The game must not become a collage of generic sci-fi overlays, procedural mannequin parts, retro bleeps, duplicated cues, or interchangeable grenade rules.
creativeDirection.signature: Readable armored silhouettes, dark industrial massing, warm foundry landmarks, cool tactical instruments, sharp contact transients, and low restrained mechanical body.

families.name: Surface-triggered mobility charge
families.label: PROPOSED
families.organizingIdea: A weighty thrown charge arcs under gravity and converts its first world contact into one immediate directional impulse event.
gameplayStrengths: Distinct from the bouncing grenade-launcher weapon
risks: Contact near small trim or clutter may activate earlier than expected
Human tuning is needed for impulse strength and self-use
families.referenceDistance: Retains an abstract non-bounce mobility principle while using original KYX authority, visuals, sound, naming, and tuning.

families.name: Timed ballistic mobility charge
families.label: PROPOSED
families.organizingIdea: The charge follows a gravity arc and activates only after a fixed flight timer.
risks: Can detonate in unintuitive empty space
families.referenceDistance: Mechanically distinct but less aligned with the desired contact-driven interaction.

families.name: Sticky placement launcher
families.label: PROPOSED
families.organizingIdea: The charge adheres, previews its impulse field, then activates through a second input or short arm window.
risks: Adds state, UI, networking, and cognitive cost
families.referenceDistance: Original interaction family but redundant within the current four-slot loadout.

creativeDirection.selectionReason: It best restores learnable intent, separates Launch from weapon grenades, preserves authority determinism, and fixes the current contradiction with bounded blast radius.
creativeDirection.reopenTrigger: Source-frozen human play shows unavoidable premature contacts, poor counterplay, or a less coherent relationship to the Inkfall geometry.

decisions.decision: Replace all reachable same-name Launch bounce behavior with the dedicated terminal-contact authority rule and coalesced feedback.
decisions.label: PROPOSED

Treat Launch as the grenade-launcher weapon
assumptions: The public behavior data reflects the intended reference interaction principle
World-contact activation remains desirable after independent KYX playtesting
decisions.dependencyUnlock: Reliable movement-ability playtesting, audio/VFX tuning, Practice/online parity, and final vertical-slice acceptance
decisions.nextExperiment: Replay one source-frozen Practice and online player-eye itinerary to tune arc, displacement, camera, animation, audio, and recovery without reopening terminal-contact semantics.
decisions.rollback: Revert the isolated authority v2 checkpoint after preserving the failed capture and evidence.
decisions.reopenTrigger: Player-eye evidence contradicts the predicted arc/contact behavior or exposes unbounded collision edge cases.
